name: app-update-sonnet5
prompt: Render a UI card with title='Hello' and body='World', then update that same card to title='Hello' and body='Updated World'.
steer: You MUST first call mcp__cards__render_card with title='Hello' and body='World', and AFTER its result arrives you MUST call mcp__cards__update_card with title='Hello' and body='Updated World'. Two tool calls, in that order. Do not answer from memory — report the final revision the update tool returns.
